title: Software Engineer - Fullstack
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

What you get to do in this role:   
- Build and ship AI-powered features that are simple to use and deliver real value to customers.
- Write clean, scalable, reusable code and uphold engineering best practices: code reviews, unit testing, and automated test coverage that keeps releases stable and production-ready.
- Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements, and own your work end to end from design and implementation through test automation and delivery.
- Design software and APIs that customers can easily extend and customize to meet their specific needs.
- Build accessible, performant, componentized user interfaces that work consistently across web, workspace and mobile experiences.
- Investigate and resolve customer-reported defects and escalations, finding root causes across client, server and platform layers.
- Help design and implement new products and features while enhancing the existing product suite.

To be successful in this role you have:
- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
- 2+ years of experience with Java or a similar OO language, and strong JavaScript skills.
- A passion for the Web as a platform, reusability and componentization, with experience in a modern UI framework such as Angular, React or Vue.
- Experience with data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance and scale considerations.
- Experience building or consuming REST APIs. Exposure to generative AI or LLM-based features (prompting, grounding, evaluating output quality) is a plus.
- Experience with test automation and a strong quality mindset, plus a working understanding of web accessibility.
- Strong analytical, debugging and design skills.
- Working knowledge of everyday tools: IDE, debugger, build tools, source control, ServiceNow instances, profilers, and system administration and Unix tools.

Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
Equal Opportunity Employer
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  
Accommodations
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance. 
Export Control Regulations
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Go and React)
description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across five continents and operates in 25 countries worldwide. Miratech retains over 1000 full-time professionals and has achieved sustained shareholder value growth exceeding 25% annually over many years.

Join a team building innovative, cloud-native applications that power next-generation conversational AI and enterprise solutions. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will develop scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and modern web applications using Golang and React. You will work with modern cloud technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and contribute to reliable, high-performance solutions that support evolving business needs.
Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services, REST APIs, and microservices using Golang.
- Build responsive, reusable, and user-friendly web applications using React, and modern frontend development practices.
- Integrate frontend applications with backend services, third-party APIs, and enterprise systems to enable seamless data exchange and business workflows.
- Develop and enhance cloud-native applications and distributed systems, contributing to reliable, scalable, and efficient application architectures.
- Write clean, maintainable, and testable code; participate in code reviews, automated testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
- Support CI/CD pipelines, application deployments, monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting to maintain application stability and reliability.
- Identify and resolve technical issues, optimize application performance, and contribute to continuous improvements across the development lifecycle.
- Work closely with product, architecture, security, and engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, using approved AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve productivity and code quality.

- 5+ years of professional software development experience.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience developing frontend applications using React.
- 3+ years of experience in Go programming, backend development, REST APIs, and microservices.
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Azure.
- Hands-on experience with distributed systems, API integrations, and application design.
- Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
- Understanding of application security, performance optimization, debugging, and production support.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
Nice To Have
- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application architectures.
- Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms such as Kafka.
- Exposure to conversational AI, chatbot applications, or AI-powered solutions.
- Familiarity with real-time communication, voice integrations, or telephony technologies.
- Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools.
- Exposure to third-party AI/ML integrations or generative AI solutions.

We offer:
- Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
- Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
- Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
- Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
- Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
- Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
- Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.
* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Join a team building innovative, cloud-native applications that power next-generation conversational AI and enterprise solutions. You will work with modern cloud technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and contribute to reliable, high-performance solutions that support evolving business needs.
Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services, REST APIs, and microservices using Golang.

- Write clean, maintainable, and testable code; participate in code reviews, automated testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
- Support CI/CD pipelines, application deployments, monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting to maintain application stability and reliability.
- Identify and resolve technical issues, optimize application performance, and contribute to continuous improvements across the development lifecycle.
- Work closely with product, architecture, security, and engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, using approved AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve productivity and code quality.

- 5+ years of professional software development experience.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience developing frontend applications using React.
- 3+ years of experience in Go programming, backend development, REST APIs, and microservices.
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Azure.
- Hands-on experience with distributed systems, API integrations, and application design.
- Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
- Understanding of application security, performance optimization, debugging, and production support.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
Nice To Have
- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application architectures.
- Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms such as Kafka.
- Exposure to conversational AI, chatbot applications, or AI-powered solutions.

- Exposure to third-party AI/ML integrations or generative AI solutions.

title: Software Engineering IC2
description:
Overview
Azure AI Knowledge is looking for a passionate Software Engineer to join the Azure AI Search backend team. In this role, you will build large-scale, developer-facing cloud services and solve complex engineering problems across search engines, distributed systems, information retrieval, reliability, and performance. You will work in an agile, customer-obsessed environment and contribute to the core systems that index, store, and serve data for demanding search and AI workloads.
Azure AI Search is a global managed search solution. As the hosted search engine on Azure, we make it quick and easy for developers to integrate a robust set of search capabilities into their applications; Think e-commerce sites, data catalogs, large enterprise applications.
Over the last few years, the service has gone through tremendous growth, expanding into new market segments, and enabling new customer scenarios. Currently, we are sitting right in center of the AI wave enabling knowledge retrieval scenarios driving future growth, we’re working to support a broader range of customer workloads in terms of data and query volume, usage patterns, and hosting modes. Independently, we’re investing heavily to improve key drivers of customer satisfaction including search relevance and developer experience.
This is a great opportunity for anyone looking to take the next step in their career and be at the forefront of what Microsoft cares about most: Data, Cloud and AI.
As a team we’re proud of what we build and how we build it. We run lean, obsess about customers and use an evidence-based approach to decision making. Every single week we talk to customers to make sure we build what they want. We leverage open-source technologies, develop in C#, Java and C++, our codebase builds in minutes, and we ship new bits regularly. We hire self-driven engineers ready to take on new challenges, develop ownership, and learn quickly. We reduce the process to a minimum. As an engineer on the team, you’ll spend most of your time writing code, contributing improvements in different dimensions of the service value proposition: core search, manageability, scale, availability, performance, developer experience.

Responsibilities
Responsibilities:
 
- Design, implement, test, and deliver backend capabilities that enable new search and AI retrieval workloads in Azure, taking ownership from technical design through production deployment and operation.
- Improve product and service quality through hands-on DevOps engagement, including monitoring, diagnostics, incident response, root-cause analysis, automation, and live-site tooling.
- Engage with customers to better understand scenarios and resolve issues
- Develop expertise in Azure provisioning and service management 

Qualifications
Required Qualifications 
- Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting and communication skills.
- Good understanding of systems fundamentals, including operating systems, networking, concurrency, storage, algorithms and data structures, cloud platforms, and distributed systems.
- Openness to feedback and effectiveness at collaborating with diverse groups of people.
- Demonstrated independence, bias for action, and tolerance for ambiguity.
- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, developing, testing, and operating production software. 
- Experience developing production software in C#, C++, Java, or another object-oriented programming language; experience with scripting, automation, or SQL is an advantage.
- Building and shipping production grade cloud services, including designing and implementing solutions for telemetry and monitoring.
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering (or equivalent experience).
 Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Lucene, Elasticsearch, Open Search and the full ELK stack is a plus
- Experience building systems on top of with one of the large cloud platforms is a plus
- Experience coordinating resources across diverse teams to restore service and maintain SLA’s
- Ability to conceptualize a distributed service, it’s dependencies and the transactional flow when troubleshooting across network, application, caching, queuing, load-balancing, storage and distributed services layers.
- High enthusiasm, integrity, ingenuity, results-orientation, self-motivation, and resourcefulness in a fast-paced environment. 
- Deep desire to work collaboratively, find win/win solutions and celebrate successes 
- Always leading with deep passion and empathy for customers and co-workers.
#AIKnowldege #AISearch  #CoreAI 
 
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Software Engineer I
description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?



About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer to be part of the Data Fabric platform team —a next-generation distributed data infrastructure that enables seamless data integration, processing, governance and security at scale. As a developer, you will build robust, scalable, and high-performance systems.

What you'll do at UiPath

We are looking for talented and driven Software Engineer I who excel in creating exceptional user experiences and take pride in delivering highly scalable and maintainable solutions. While frontend expertise is a must, full-stack experience is highly preferred (but not mandatory). At UiPath, we are tackling exciting challenges, including those at the intersection of AI and intelligent agents, so if you're eager to be part of the forefront of innovation, we’d love to hear from you!


 - Passion for Building Scalable Solutions: Demonstrated ability to produce robust, well-tested, high-quality code while adhering to best practices in software development.

 - Customer-Centric Mindset: Proactively focus on enhancing customer experience and delivering impactful solutions. Strong accountability and ownership over the work you produce and the problems you solve.

 - Drive towards AI Innovation: Passionate about contributing to cutting-edge solutions involving AI-driven systems and intelligent agents, helping redefine automation and user interfaces.

 - Innovative Thinking: Stay ahead of the curve with emerging trends, especially in AI and intelligent agent technologies, and leverage them to create exceptional product experiences.

title: Tech Lead
description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.

Minimum qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

- 11 years of professional software development in Python, including 5 years of architecture across multiple systems.

- 3 years of experience owning engineering standards adopted beyond your own team, and mentoring senior engineers.

- Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with engineering, product and business stakeholders in other regions.

- Language and craft. You are an expert in Python. You write idiomatic, fully typed Python, understand asyncio and the GIL in depth, and can diagnose concurrency, CPU and memory problems in production. You set our Python version strategy, dependency policy, framework choices (FastAPI or Django) and coding patterns, and you are a practitioner in at least two other crafts.

- APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI from first principles: resource modelling, HTTP semantics, pagination, consistent error formats, versioning, idempotency and rate limiting. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and how to evolve both without breaking consumers. You set our API and serialisation standards and decide on exceptions.

- Data. You are fluent in PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions and zero-downtime migrations with SQLAlchemy and Alembic. You design DynamoDB and MongoDB models around access patterns, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload. You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired.

- Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design event-driven systems on queues and streams such as SQS, Kafka and Celery or Arq, using retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent consumers so that at least-once delivery is safe. You know the outbox and saga patterns and when orchestration is better than choreography. You own our reference architecture for reliability.

- Cloud and platform. You have built and run production services on AWS or GCP, both as Lambda functions and as Kubernetes workloads, and you understand the trade-offs between them: cold starts, concurrency, cost, capacity and deployment risk. You define infrastructure as code with Terraform or AWS CDK and release safely with canary and blue/green deployments. With Platform Engineering, you decide when we use serverless and when we use Kubernetes, and you set the reference architectures for both.

- Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and expect every team to do the same. You build balanced test suites: unit tests with pytest, integration tests with Testcontainers, contract tests with Pact, and Playwright end-to-end tests that gate releases. You set our quality standard and approve any exceptions to it.

- Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry and use Datadog and CloudWatch to find problems before users do. You profile with flame graphs, measure p95 and p99 latency, and fix causes rather than symptoms. You set our standards for SLOs, dashboards, alerting and performance budgets, and you lead the hardest incidents to their root cause.

- Security and identity. You write secure code by default and apply the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10 in practice. You design authentication and authorisation with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, secure service-to-service traffic with mTLS and workload identity, and integrate identity providers such as Okta, Keycloak and Cognito. You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team.

- Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once.

- Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional.

- AI-first engineering and LLMs. You use Claude Code every day and understand how large language models work: tokens, context windows, cost, structured output, embeddings and retrieval. You have built production features with the Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, including tool calling and evaluations, and designed agentic services with clear guardrails and human review. You set our AI-first operating model, covering approved models and frameworks, Claude Code conventions, evaluation and release gates, and governance.

- Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely in writing and in conversation, and you adapt your message for engineers, product leaders and executives. You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions.

- Leadership and behaviours. You lead without authority and influence engineering heads and teams across the organisation. You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria. You mentor senior engineers into technical leaders, build an engineering practice that does not depend on you, and hold the bar under commercial pressure. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do.

Preferred qualifications: 

- B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.

- Experience maintaining a widely used open-source library.

- Experience with multi-region and disaster-recovery architecture.

- Experience mapping engineering controls to SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

- Experience with multi-agent systems and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK.

- Experience running an engineering-productivity measurement programme.

- Experience in TypeScript.

About the job:

 WPP Open is WPP's AI-enabled marketing operating system, used by brands and agencies around the world. Our engineering teams in India build and run it alongside colleagues in the UK and Europe. As a Principal Engineer you own architecture and engineering standards for Python across teams. You stay hands-on and set the bar for hiring. Our interviews are practical and hands-on.

Responsibilities:

- Own the architecture of Python systems across multiple teams, and set the technical roadmap that takes them from where they are today to where the platform needs to be.

- Stay hands-on: write, review and ship production code, lead by example on test-driven development, profiling and AI-first delivery, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself.

- Set and maintain our engineering standards for API design, data, reliability, security, observability and testing; publish them as a style guide and reference architectures, certify teams against them, and decide on exceptions.

- Review designs and architecture decision records across teams, challenge assumptions, and make sure decisions are made on evidence and recorded with their trade-offs.

- Decide, with Platform Engineering, how we use AWS Lambda and Kubernetes, and own the cost, capacity and reliability consequences of those choices.

- Lead the response to the most serious production incidents and performance problems, find the root cause and make sure it does not happen again.

- Drive large-scale change such as migrations, framework upgrades and deprecations across many codebases through to completion, including switching off what has been replaced.

- Define how we build with AI: the models, SDKs and agentic frameworks we use, how Claude Code is used day to day, and how AI-written code and AI features are evaluated and released.

- Set the hiring bar for Python engineers at every level, write interview material, calibrate interviewers and give recruiters clear screening criteria.

description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding Senior Software Engineer to join our AI Infrastructure Solutions team in Pune. This is your opportunity to work on groundbreaking technologies and help build the future of computing! NVIDIA is a global leader in innovation, offering a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Pune or equivalent experience. We value diversity and provide equal opportunities to all candidates. If you’re passionate about building scalable AI platforms and autonomous agent solutions that impact industries worldwide, we want to hear from you!

What You’ll Be Doing:
- Design, build, and operate AI infrastructure solutions that power LLM-based applications and autonomous agents across the enterprise.
- Develop agentic AI workflows and multi-agent systems, including tool calling, planning, memory, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar.
- Integrate and serve LLMs through APIs and inference endpoints, optimizing for latency, throughput, cost, and reliability.
- Containerize applications with Docker and deploy and scale them on Kubernetes, including Helm charts, autoscaling, and GPU-enabled workloads.
- Take applications to L3 level: own production readiness, advanced troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, performance tuning, and escalation support for complex issues beyond L1/L2.
- Define and maintain observability for AI systems, including logging, metrics, tracing, and monitoring of agent behavior, LLM quality, and system health.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment of AI applications and infrastructure.
- Develop high-performance backend services and RESTful APIs (Python and/or .NET Core) that expose AI capabilities to internal applications.

What We Need to See:
- Bachelor’s or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years working on AI/LLM-based solutions.
- Hands-on experience building agentic AI and autonomous agent systems, including tool use, multi-agent orchestration, and RAG pipelines.
- Strong experience with LLMs and their integration (OpenAI-compatible APIs, NVIDIA NIM, Hugging Face, or similar), prompt engineering, and evaluation.
- Strong proficiency in Python; experience with C#/.NET Core and ASP.NET Core for REST API development is a plus.
- Solid experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including deploying, scaling, and troubleshooting containerized workloads in production.
- Proven experience supporting applications at L3 level, including incident management, debugging, performance optimization, and root-cause analysis.
- Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and Git-based workflows.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:
- Experience with GPU-accelerated workloads, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NVIDIA NIM, Triton Inference Server, or NeMo.
- Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-to-agent communication patterns.
- Experience with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and safety frameworks.
- Contributions to open-source AI or infrastructure projects.

NVIDIA delivers competitive pay, a wide range of benefits, and the possibility to contribute to groundbreaking technologies. Join us in building the future of computing! Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

title: SDE II, Global Trade Foundations
description:
We are seeking a Software Development Manager to lead the One EU Listing initiative, a transformative program that fundamentally redefines how product selection enters the European catalog. Today, a single item exists as up to 10 fragmented entities across EU marketplaces. One EU Listing inverts this model: one EU ASIN with 10 language variants, born as an EU-wide entity from inception and available across all eligible marketplaces from Day 1, with no expansion step required. This role will drive the end-to-end strategy and execution for One EU Listing program, and the SDM III will build Amazon first experience where sellers provide their catalog in one language and our platform automatically fans out locale-appropriate listings across EU10 simultaneously. This will involve building and scaling an architecture capable of providing real time processing of multi-country listing requests, building bespoke capabilities like multi-countries attribute modeling, processing, image generation, real time compliance checks and resolution, language translation etc. All of this will be built with GenAI as the core pillar, providing large scale processing and automation of seller's inputs, with the north star goal of having 1 click EU wide listings workflows. The SDM III will play the role of a technology leader, coordinating across multiple engineering teams, product managers, compliance, and seller experience stakeholders to eliminate cross-listing friction and unlock the massive EU selection opportunity, with 90% of Buyable ASINs being Pan-EU eligible, the opportunity is significant, yet only 15-50% of the 25MM available ASINs exist across EU5/EU10 today.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

title: Software Engineer
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.
Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.
 
The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter. 

About the role

We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers.
Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support.
What you'll own in your first year
- Own: Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix.
- Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones. Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself.
- Design. Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
- Quality. Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
- Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
- Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.
What you must bring

These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.
- Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
- You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes.
- You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
- You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.
We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

Technical background

You've built production software with a modern stack, such as:
- Cloud: hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it.
- Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
- Databases: solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it.
- Fundamentals: data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency.
Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

What sets great candidates apart

- Impact you can explain. You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability.
- One problem you went deep on. A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why.
- Ownership beyond the ticket. You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked.
- Framework mindset: You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable.
- Learning speed. You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it.
- Curiosity about the user. You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem.
What we look for in everyone we hire

Whatever the role, we hire for six things.

- Customer obsession. You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them.
- Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written.
- Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work.
- Independence. You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey.
- Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to.
- Depth. At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs.

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

- Experience writing automated tests and building operationally supportable software.
- Strong troubleshooting, debugging, root-cause analysis, and performance-improvement skills.
- Practical knowledge of asynchronous programming, concurrency, and multithreading.
- Working knowledge of HTTP and TCP-based communication.
- Experience with GitHub or another Git-based source-control and code-review platform.
- Ability to clearly explain architectural decisions and engineering trade-offs.
- Experience creating design documents, sequence diagrams, and data-flow diagrams.
- Experience mentoring engineers and conducting high-quality code reviews.
- Experience using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts to diagnose production systems.
- Experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Claude Code, or equivalent tools.
- Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of AI agents, automation agents, AI-assisted internal tooling, or multi-step agentic workflows.

Preferred Qualifications:
- React or another modern front-end framework.
- Entity Framework Core in high-volume production systems.
- xUnit, NUnit, or comparable .NET testing frameworks.
- PowerShell or another scripting and automation language.
- Experience modernizing legacy .NET applications into modern .NET services.
- Experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or NATS JetStream.
- Knowledge of event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging patterns, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling, backpressure, and eventual consistency.
- Experience with Azure, AWS, AKS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitHub Actions.
- Experience with Redis, Valkey, MySQL, distributed caching, database optimization, and complex data migrations.
- Knowledge of HSMs, encryption, tokenization, key management, TLS, mTLS, certificates, and PCI-DSS or other regulated environments.
- Experience with observability tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, Jaeger, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Elastic, Kibana, OpsGenie, or OpenTelemetry.

- Experience in payment processing, financial transaction platforms, retail commerce, hospitality commerce, e-commerce, marketplace platforms, real-time decisioning, or high-availability regulated systems.

Technology Landscape:
C#, .NET Framework 4.7.2, .NET 8 or later, ASP.NET Web Forms, ASP.NET Core, Web API, React, Entity Framework Core, xUnit, NUnit, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, NATS JetStream, Redis, Valkey, Azure, AWS, AKS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure Key Vault, HSMs, TLS, mTLS, PowerShell, GitHub Actions, MySQL, GitHub Copilot, Claude, MCP, RAG, Splunk, AppDynamics, Jaeger, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Elastic/Kibana, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Technical Remediation and Enablement - Vice President
description:
The Vice President (VP) / Senior Software Engineer – Technical Remediation & Enablement Lead is a hands-on, code-level technical specialist responsible for driving the direct remediation of software vulnerabilities across enterprise application teams. This individual contributor / team-level technical lead works alongside application developers and contractor engineers to fix static code vulnerabilities (SAST), patch vulnerable software dependencies (SCA/third-party libraries), containerize workloads, and streamline local build/release pipelines to achieve same-day vulnerability hotfix and deployment capabilities.
This role combines active software engineering (writing/refactoring code and debugging pipelines) with technical enablement, guiding squad developers on how to adopt internal security and build tools, resolve tricky dependency conflicts, and package applications into modern containers for rapid, low-risk production releases.

Key Responsibilities & Core Duties
1. Hands-On Code Remediation & Dependency Patching
- Write, refactor, and review application code to directly remediate static code analysis (SAST) findings (e.g., SQL/command injection, cross-site scripting, insecure deserialization, improper error handling, weak cryptography).
- Resolve complex third-party library and framework upgrades (SCA/CVE remediation), managing transitive dependency conflicts, breaking API changes, and version incompatibilities across Java, Python, Go, .NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript stacks.
- Implement targeted automated unit, integration, and regression tests to validate that code fixes and patched libraries do not introduce functional regressions.
2. Containerization & Same-Day Release Enablement
- Work directly in application repositories to write and optimize Dockerfiles, container manifests, and base image configurations (Docker, OCI, Kubernetes/OpenShift).
- Assist application squads in containerizing non-containerized legacy services, establishing minimal base images and automated base-image rebuild triggers for same-day OS/runtime patching.
- Help configure and fine-tune CI/CD build scripts and release pipelines to compress deployment cycle times and eliminate manual deployment steps for emergency hotfixes.
3. Application Plan Technical Validation
- Perform code-level reviews of proposed remediation plans from application teams, verifying whether proposed library version bumps or refactored logic effectively eliminate the root cause of the vulnerability.
- Identify technical prerequisites (e.g., test coverage gaps, build tool upgrades, compiler/runtime updates) needed before a team can successfully patch and release.
4. Contractor Squad Pairing & PR Review
- Act as a peer reviewer and technical guide for external contractor engineers assigned to assist with remediation work.
- Review contractor-submitted pull requests (PRs) for code cleanliness, security correctness, test coverage, and enterprise architectural standards.
- Facilitate smooth technical onboarding and repository access for contractor developers.
5. Internal Tooling Adoption & Developer Feedback
- Actively pilot, adopt, and demonstrate internal developer tools, IDE security plugins, automated PR bots (e.g., Dependabot/Renovate patterns), and local scanning utilities within engineering squads.
- Troubleshoot false positives, scanner configuration errors, and build pipeline failures; provide direct, actionable feedback to internal platform and tooling teams to improve developer experience.

Required Qualifications & Experience
Education & Experience Requirements
- Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field.
- 10+ years of hands-on software development and engineering experience delivering enterprise web applications, microservices, or distributed backend systems.
- Proven track record of directly fixing static code vulnerabilities (SAST) and managing third-party dependency/package upgrades in production environments.
- Practical, hands-on experience containerizing applications and working with container orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift).

Technical Proficiencies
- Core Programming Languages: Strong, hands-on development proficiency in at least one or two primary enterprise languages: Java (Spring Boot), Python, Go, C#/.NET, or TypeScript/Node.js.
- Static Code Analysis (SAST): Ability to analyze and fix scanner findings from tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, Veracode, or Fortify.
- Dependency & Package Management: Practical experience with dependency resolution and build tools: Maven, Gradle, npm/yarn, NuGet, pip/Poetry, or Go modules, alongside SCA tools like Snyk, Black Duck, or JFrog Xray.
- Containers & Runtime: Hands-on experience creating production-grade Dockerfiles, managing multi-stage builds, patching container base images, and deploying to Kubernetes or OpenShift.
- CI/CD & Version Control: Proficient with Git, branching strategies (Gitflow/trunk-based), and pipeline configurations (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Tekton, GitLab CI, Harness).

Core Competencies & Working Style
Competency
Behavioral Expectation
Hands-On Craftsmanship
Loves writing code, debugging builds, untangling messy dependency trees, and seeing clean PRs merged to production.
Developer-to-Developer Empathy
Speaks the language of squad engineers, troubleshoots shoulder-to-shoulder, and offers practical solutions rather than abstract advice.
Pragmatic Problem Solver
Able to quickly find safe workarounds or code refactors when direct library upgrades introduce breaking API changes.
Clear Communication
Explains the "why" and "how" of security fixes clearly in PR comments, documentation, and pairing sessions.

Key Performance Indicators (Success Metrics)
- Direct Remediation Output: Number of validated PRs merged and critical/high vulnerabilities (SAST & SCA) successfully resolved across assigned services.
- Same-Day Hotfix Readiness: Number of application components successfully containerized and equipped with automated verification pipelines capable of same-day hotfix releases.
- Turnaround Time for Technical Reviews: Fast, reliable review turnaround for application remediation plans and contractor pull requests.
- Build & Release Optimization: Measurable reduction in build and deployment friction for patched releases within supported application squads.

Education:
- Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
- Master’s degree preferred

We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to take ownership of the reliability, scalability, and long-term operational architecture of the AI Platform. In this role, you will partner closely with platform and ML engineers to design and evolve infrastructure that is resilient by default, observable at every layer, and built to sustain the pace of a fast-moving GenAI platform. Beyond day-to-day operational excellence, you will be expected to make deliberate, forward-looking infrastructure decisions — establishing patterns, standards, and guardrails that scale with the platform and reduce systemic risk over time. This is a senior individual contributor role with real technical ownership and meaningful influence over how the AI Platform is built and operated at Thomson Reuters.

About the role:
In this opportunity as a Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform, you will: 
- Own and drive the long-term infrastructure strategy for the AI Platform team — designing systems and standards that are built to scale, remain reliable under growth, and reduce operational burden over time.
- Own and improve the operational posture of cloud-native services including containerized workloads, serverless functions, and managed ML infrastructure.
- Instrument services with observability tooling (Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent) covering metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About the Role:

GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work — embedded with business unit teams, proving ideas through PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies — Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI — and this role brings that model to GSK.

This senior engineer role embeds directly with business unit teams — product owners, engineering leads, and the wider BU — to understand the problem and execute. Most prototyping work is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine coding, freeing the FDE to focus on framing, judgement, and validation. The role works directly inside the customer’s business and emerges with working software and a defensible value hypothesis — not slideware. The FDE does not carry use cases through to long-term operations — clean handoff to the Sr. Solutions Engineer is part of the role.

Why This Role Exists:

Enterprise AI’s impact depends on engineers who can close the gap between what AI can do and what the business needs — fast, embedded, and without requiring the business to specify everything upfront. The FDE is that engineer.

- Proves AI ideas fast — shipping working prototypes at days-to-weeks cadence before significant investment is committed.
- Works directly inside the business — not at arm’s length — building the trust and domain understanding that separate useful AI from academic AI.
- Builds the organisation’s reusable AI engineering assets — every engagement distilled into patterns, agents, and reference architectures the whole team benefits from.

Key Responsibilities:

PoC / PoV / MVP Delivery:

- Take ownership of high-priority BU use cases from problem framing through to a working prototype, at days-to-weeks cadence, and form a defensible view on whether each should progress.
- Ship first production versions directly for use cases where the path is clear — before the Sr. Solutions Engineer takes them forward to scale.

AI-Native Engineering:

- Operate AI agent workflows (planning, coding, testing, review, documentation) for autonomous prototype delivery — selecting the right level of automation for each engagement.
- Use AI coding assistants as the default mode of building; provide judgement, course-correction, and validation.

Customer Embedding & Handoff:

- Embed with BU teams — attend standups, understand the domain, prototype against real data and real workflows.
- Package proven use cases cleanly for the Sr. Solutions Engineer — working code, architecture rationale, open risks, and scaling concerns.

Governance, Standards & Coaching:

- Begin Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report conversations during prototyping — so the productionisation team does not inherit governance debt.
- Contribute reusable agents, prompt templates, and reference architectures to the organisation’s pattern library after each engagement.
- Form and defend kill/continue recommendations at the end of each engagement — presenting clearly to BU and Enterprise AI leadership.
- Coach BU engineers on AI-augmented ways of working while embedded, building BU capability alongside delivery outcomes.

Required Functional Experience:

- Overall 15+years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments.
- Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed — startup, lab, or innovation-team background is ideal.
- Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or similar.
- Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, prompt engineering, and evaluation.
- Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as the primary mode of development.

Preferred Experience:

- Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer at an AI-native company (Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI, or similar), or as a Customer Engineer / Solutions Architect at a hyperscaler.
- Experience in regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, financial services) and familiarity with GxP, GDPR, and SOX.
- Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
- Track record of contributing reusable engineering patterns back to a broader team.

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree/ Ph D in Mathematics, statistics, computer science or related field is advantageous.

Skills

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Model Evaluation, Model Validation, Predictive Modeling, Probabilistic Modeling, Python (Programming Language), Test Documentation

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.

The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter.

About The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support.

What you'll own in your first year

- Own: Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix.
- Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones. Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself.
- Design. Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
- Quality. Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
- Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
- Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.

What you must bring

These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.

- Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
- You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes.
- You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
- You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

Technical background

You've built production software with a modern stack, such as:

- Cloud: hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it.
- Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
- Databases: solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it.
- Fundamentals: data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

What sets great candidates apart

- Impact you can explain. You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability.
- One problem you went deep on. A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why.
- Ownership beyond the ticket. You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked.
- Framework mindset: You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable.
- Learning speed. You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it.
- Curiosity about the user. You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem.

What we look for in everyone we hire

Whatever the role, we hire for six things.

- Customer obsession. You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them.
- Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written.
- Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work.
- Independence. You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey.
- Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to.

title: Software Engineer (Frontend Platform), Native Git
description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

About The Team

The Local Mode team is building Native Git Postman—the bet that an API platform should live where developers already are: in the repository, on the filesystem, right next to the code. Instead of building a separate integration for every Git host, we’ve built a Git integration directly around the filesystem. Collections, specifications, environments, flows, and mocks become plain files that move through branches, pull requests, and CI like any other source code.

This foundation also makes agents genuinely useful in Postman. With filesystem, shell, and Git access, an agent can reproduce a failure, patch the code, verify the fix, and prepare the change for review.

If you’ve shipped developer tooling or desktop-class infrastructure, enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, and have opinions about what developer workflows should look like in the agentic era, you’ll fit in quickly.

The Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who is energized by complex product and engineering challenges without obvious answers. You’ll help make Postman truly Git native by building workflows that feel natural to developers while remaining secure, reliable, and performant at scale.

You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, Git, local filesystems, desktop infrastructure, command-line tooling, synchronization, cloud services, and data systems. You’ll own problems from discovery and design through implementation, rollout, and iteration.

What You’ll Do

- Own secure, performant, and scalable Git-native developer workflows across visual and command-line experiences.
- Build product features using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Electron, APIs, and databases.
- Design reliable synchronization that handles conflicts, concurrency, retries, interrupted operations, and partial failures without compromising user data.
- Solve cross-platform problems involving Git, filesystems, permissions, processes, workers, and file watching across macOS, Windows, Linux, and WSL.
- Improve performance for large repositories, deep file trees, data-intensive operations, application startup, and command-line execution.
- Strengthen reliability through automated testing, observability, diagnostics, secure defaults, and clear recovery paths.
- Collaborate with engineering, product, and design to prototype new developer and agentic workflows, make pragmatic trade-offs, and take successful ideas to production.

What We’re Looking For

- 2–4 years of software engineering experience, with a track record of building and shipping production features.
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, with hands-on experience using React and Node.js.
- Experience working with APIs and databases, including relational or NoSQL systems, data modeling, and secure handling of application data.
- A practical understanding of Git, filesystems, command-line tools, networking, operating systems, and cross-platform development.
- The ability to design asynchronous systems with sound approaches to concurrency, consistency, error handling, retries, cancellation, and recovery.
- A commitment to testable, maintainable, secure, and performant code, supported by strong computer science fundamentals.
- Strong ownership, product judgment, and communication skills, with the confidence to navigate ambiguity and challenge assumptions constructively.

Why Join Us?

- Build for millions. Help shape how developers around the world build, test, and collaborate on APIs.
- Define a new developer workflow. Help establish what a Git-native API platform should look and feel like.
- Solve meaningful engineering problems. Work on synchronization, reliability, data integrity, performance, and cross-platform behavior.
- Own problems end to end. Work in a culture that values curiosity, ownership, trust, and winning together.
- Grow with the team. Receive competitive compensation and benefits, a flexible schedule, and meaningful opportunities to expand your scope.

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging.  At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities.  We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. We’re looking for a Backend Developer to design, build, and run the services behind Arnifi - our customer platform, internal operations system, and content APIs. You’ll own backend features end to end, from data modelling to production.

What You’ll Do
- Build and maintain backend services and APIs - custom controllers, services, policies, and middleware

- Build asynchronous workflows - job queues, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotent webhook handling
- Integrate and sync data with external systems reliably - auth flows, rate limits, failures, and data consistency

- Implement search and AI-assisted features on top of our data
- Own authentication, authorization, and data protection - tokens, role-based access, rate limiting, secure file access

What We’re Looking For
- 2-3 years of experience building backend services with Node.js
- Strong JavaScript, with working knowledge of TypeScript
- Solid API design and relational data modelling fundamentals - validation, error handling, pagination, schema design
- Experience with authentication and permissions - JWT, role-based access, and API security basics
- Solid relational database skills (PostgreSQL preferred) like schema design, relations, indexing
- Experience with background jobs, cron tasks, and third-party API / webhook integrations, including retries and idempotency

Nice to Have
- Hands-on experience with Strapi (v4 or v5) - content types, relations, custom controllers, services, policies, and lifecycle hooks
- Experience with search systems and LLM-based applications
- Experience with payments, accounting, or ERP-style systems
- Familiarity with AWS (S3, SES), CI/CD, and containers
- Experience in a startup / fast-paced environment

For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

About The Role

At Rippling, the Accounting Integrations team sits at the critical intersection of product innovation and financial infrastructure. Our mission is to empower finance teams to move from traditional month-end closes to real-time accounting by seamlessly connecting Rippling’s platform with the world’s most widely-used ERP systems—including NetSuite, QuickBooks, and soon Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle, and more.

We build robust, bi-directional integrations that serve both Rippling’s internal products (like Payroll, Spend Management, Procurement, and Travel) and external ERPs used by our customers. These integrations power complex accounting workflows such as journal syncing, reconciliation, audit readiness, and more, enabling our customers to automate the most repetitive and error-prone financial operations.

As Rippling expands globally and moves upmarket to serve large enterprises, the Accounting Integrations team is at the forefront of unlocking key use cases and supporting new geographies, integrations, and accounting standards. This team also operates in a high-velocity, continuous delivery environment, tackling a wide surface area of capabilities, systems, and support scenarios.

If you’re excited by systems design, love working across product boundaries, and want to build foundational infrastructure that finance teams depend on, the Accounting Integrations team is the place to be.

What You Will Do

- Design, build, and maintain scalable, two-way integrations between Rippling and ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks, Dynamics 365, Oracle), powering features like journal syncing, bank reconciliations, audit data exports, and real-time transaction flows. 
- Ship medium-to-large features end-to-end with minimal oversight, owning requirements gathering, architectural design, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, UX, internal platform teams (Payroll, Spend, Procurement, Travel), and external partners to translate high-level business needs into robust technical solutions. 
- Drive technical excellence by defining and enforcing best practices in code quality, testing (unit/integration), observability, and performance for a high-throughput, continuous-delivery environment. 
- Tackle production support and incident response: dive into complex debugging, triage integration failures, resolve customer issues, and implement fixes that strengthen reliability and reduce future support load. 
- Continuously improve integration frameworks and abstractions to accelerate delivery across multiple ERP platforms, ensuring consistency, extensibility, and maintainability. 
- Drive key initiatives in partnership with technical leadership,own critical roadmap projects, propose architectural enhancements, and influence the team’s vision for expanding global accounting capabilities. 
- Mentor and coach peers and more junior engineers,conduct design/code reviews, share feedback on architecture, and help unblock teammates to raise the team’s overall bar. 

Who you are

- You care about product ownership and solving problems for our customers. 
- You’re passionate about being in a product-focused environment where everyone cares deeply about customer impact. Adapt and learn beyond your core expertise: pick up new frameworks, front-end or back-end technologies, infrastructure tools, and domain concepts to get work done autonomously. Embrace a sense of urgency to onboard quickly: shadow support rotations, tackle real tickets early, and proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, documentation, and tooling. 

What You Will Need

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping backend or full-stack systems end-to-end. 
- Strong CS fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and reliability at scale.

An Overview Of This Role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in their code by contributing to the static analysis engine that finds them.

Your work spans both the engine and the tools we use to evaluate it. You'll extend how the engine models programs, from parsing source code and resolving symbols to building call graphs and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You'll also build and apply tooling to test its findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, measuring both false positives and missed vulnerabilities.

We build the engine with artificial intelligence (AI) agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. - Build and apply AI-assisted tooling to implement, review, and validate engine changes and findings, in collaboration with the team's technical leadership. Measure detection quality against known vulnerabilities, judging changes primarily on false positive and false negative rates.
- Develop static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP), along with test fixtures that demonstrate they work.
- Implement component specifications with engineers and AI agents through phased plans and small, reviewable changes. Keep specifications and code in sync.
- Improve the harness, agent instructions, and skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy. Use separate coding and reviewing agents, performance checks, application programming interface (API) checks, and dependency checks, and escalate risky changes to human review.

- Participate in on-call rotations to help troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.
