- Experience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to assess when their output is trustworthy.
- Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Rust or Go. Our engine is written in Rust, the analyzer wrapper in Go, and the monolith integration in Ruby. You'll be willing to work across them.
- An interest in static analysis and application security, including parsing, intermediate representations, taint and data-flow analysis, and how vulnerabilities arise in code. Deep expertise isn't required; we'll help you grow it.
- Organize and progress your work independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.
- The ability to communicate technical problems clearly and concisely and propose iterative solutions.
- Helpful but not required: experience with performance optimization, Docker and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), web or mobile frameworks, guardrails for agent-written code such as mutation testing and fuzzing, or program analysis and security research through publications or open source contributions. Willingness to learn performance optimization and containerized workflows is also welcome.

title: Software Development Engineer, AI Trust & Innovation
description:
Description

About the Team

Amazon's Devices & Services Trust CX Innovations team is building the future of responsible AI for consumer devices. We deliver privacy-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily across Amazon's device ecosystem—including Alexa, Echo, and other ambient computing products. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain Amazon's high bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.

Role Overview

We are seeking an exceptional Software Development Engineer II to build the foundational systems and consumer-facing features that enable trustworthy AI experiences at scale. You will partner closely with our Principal Engineers and Managers to design and implement privacy-preserving AI architectures, responsible AI frameworks, and accessibility features that set the standard for consumer AI products.

This is a high-impact role where you'll tackle complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer trust—balancing performance with privacy, building explainable AI systems, and creating guardrails that protect customers while enabling delightful experiences.

Key job responsibilities

What You'll Build

Privacy-Preserving AI Systems

- Design and implement federated learning and differential privacy techniques for on-device and hybrid AI architectures
- Build privacy-preserving data pipelines that minimize data collection while maintaining model quality
- Create consent management frameworks and data minimization systems that give customers control
- Architect on-device vs. cloud processing trade-offs that optimize for both privacy and performance

Consumer-Facing Trust Features

- Develop explainable AI interfaces that help customers understand how AI makes decisions
- Build transparency controls that show customers what data is used and how
- Create privacy dashboards and settings that give customers meaningful control over their AI experiences
- Implement cross-device identity management with privacy-first design principles

Key Technical Challenges

- Latency vs. Privacy Trade-offs: Optimize time-to-first-token and response times while maintaining strong privacy guarantees through on-device processing and selective cloud offloading
 AI Safety at Scale: Reduce hallucinations to <1% while maintaining 95%+ accuracy across diverse customer queries and contexts- Ambient Computing Privacy: Build privacy controls for always-on environments that balance proactive assistance with clear boundaries
- Multimodal AI Systems: Architect distributed systems that handle text, voice, and visual inputs while preserving privacy across modalities
- Real-time Evaluation: Create low-latency evaluation systems that assess model outputs for safety, accuracy, and bias before reaching customers

What Makes You Successful

Customer Obsession for Trust: You deeply understand that trust is earned through consistent, transparent, and privacy-respecting experiences. You make technical decisions that prioritize customer trust even when it means additional complexity.

Technical Excellence: You have strong computer science fundamentals and practical experience building distributed systems. You write clean, maintainable code and establish best practices that enable your team to move fast without breaking things.

AI & Privacy Expertise: You understand both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems. You know how to implement privacy-preserving techniques without sacrificing user experience.

Bias for Action: You thrive in ambiguous environments where you need to make pragmatic trade-offs between innovation and safety. You ship iteratively and learn from customer feedback.

Inclusive Mindset: You design systems that work for all customers, considering diverse abilities, contexts, and use cases from the start rather than as an afterthought.

Why Join Us

- Work on generative AI technology that impacts millions of customers daily
- Shape the future of responsible AI and set industry standards for privacy and trust
- Partner with world-class product, design, and research teams
- Solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer protection
- Build systems that make AI accessible and trustworthy for everyone

About The Team

Amazon's Devices & Services Trust CX Innovations team is building the future of responsible AI for consumer devices. We deliver privacy-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily across Amazon's device ecosystem—including Alexa, Echo, and other ambient computing products. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain Amazon's high bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**About CARBON**

**CARBON is a Bengaluru-based men's apparel brand with an established wholesale business and a growing direct-to-consumer presence.**

**As we expand, we're looking to bring technology closer to our day-to-day business operations, from inventory and sales to ecommerce, marketing and internal processes.**

**We're an apparel business, not an IT company, and we're looking for someone who can help us build the technology side of the business from the ground up.**

**About the Role**

**We're hiring a Founding Full-Stack Developer to take charge of our technology initiatives and work closely with the management team.**

**We currently don't have a dedicated in-house IT team. This means you'll have the opportunity and responsibility to make technical decisions, build solutions and see projects through from planning to deployment.**

**This isn't a conventional developer role within an established tech team. We're looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, can work independently and is equally comfortable planning a solution and getting hands-on with the code.**

**As the business grows, this position has the potential to develop into a key technology leadership role within CARBON.**

**What You'll Be Working On**

* **Developing and maintaining web applications, internal tools and business dashboards.**
* **Building integrations between our inventory, billing, ecommerce and other business systems.**
* **Creating automation workflows to reduce repetitive work across departments.**
* **Developing AI-powered reporting tools and a centralised business intelligence platform.**
* **Building B2B digital catalogues, retailer portals and supporting our Shopify-based D2C business.**
* **Managing the technical side of projects, including architecture, development, deployment, troubleshooting and maintenance.**

* **Backend development experience with Node.js, Python or similar technologies.**
* **Experience working with databases, REST APIs and third-party integrations.**

**Experience with Shopify, Zoho, WordPress, Make.com, AI integrations or business automation would be an advantage, but isn't mandatory.**

**The Kind of Person Who Would Fit In**

**Technical skills matter, but for this role, attitude and ownership matter just as much.**

**We're looking for someone who:**

* **Takes initiative rather than waiting for detailed instructions.**

* **Can understand a business requirement, suggest a practical solution and implement it.**
* **Is resourceful, organised and willing to learn when a project calls for something new.**
* **Enjoys building systems, solving problems and seeing the impact of their work.**

**Why Join Us?**

**You'll be joining at a stage where there's plenty to build and genuine room to make a difference.**

title: AI and Automation Developer  GenAI AI Agents  Full Stack
description:
We are looking for a **hands-on AI & Automation Developer** who can convert business problems into practical AI-powered products and automated workflows.

  

This is **not a role for someone who has only completed AI courses or worked only on basic chatbots.**

  

We need a **builder with strong business acumen** who understands a business requirement, identifies what can be automated, develops the solution, integrates it with our existing systems, tests it and takes it into production.

  

The selected candidate will work directly on our existing and upcoming products including **HRMS, recruitment automation, AI agents, CV parsing, social-media automation, video/content automation, job portals and other SaaS/web platforms.**

  

Key Responsibilities

  

The candidate will be responsible for:

* Upgrade, maintain and add AI capabilities to our existing **HRMS/ERP applications**.
* Build **AI Agents and Agentic AI workflows** capable of performing multi-step business tasks.
* Develop AI agents for **social media management, content generation, lead generation, customer engagement and business operations**.
* Develop AI-powered systems for **CV/resume parsing, candidate scoring, matching, screening and recruitment automation**.
* Build and enhance **large-scale job portals, recruitment platforms, dashboards and business applications**.
* Develop AI-assisted **video/content creation and marketing automation workflows**.
* Integrate LLMs and AI APIs with existing applications.
* Automate repetitive processes across HR, recruitment, sales, marketing, operations and management.
* Build APIs, databases, dashboards and integrations required for end-to-end automation.
* Evaluate new AI tools/models and rapidly convert useful technologies into working business applications.
* Deploy, monitor and continuously improve AI applications in production.

  

What We Are Really Looking For

  

We want someone who thinks:

  

**Why is a person doing this manually? Can I automate it using AI?**

The ideal candidate should have a strong combination of **coding ability + AI knowledge + automation mindset + business understanding**.

You should be able to understand a business process, identify inefficiencies and independently propose and develop a better AI-powered solution.

Must-Have Technical Skills

  

**Strong preference will be given to candidates with hands-on experience in:**

* Python
* Generative AI / LLMs
* Agentic AI / AI Agents
* OpenAI / Gemini / Claude APIs or similar LLM APIs
* LangChain / LangGraph / equivalent agent frameworks
* RAG and Vector Databases
* Prompt Engineering
* REST APIs / API Integration
* SQL / PostgreSQL / MySQL
* Git / GitHub
* Workflow Automation
* Web Application Development
* AI-powered process automation

  

Knowledge of **React / Next.js / Node.js / FastAPI / Django** will be a major advantage.

  

Experience with tools such as **n8n, Make, Zapier or equivalent workflow automation platforms** will also be preferred.

Preferred Project Experience

  

We particularly want candidates who have already built at least some of the following:

**AI Agents | HRMS/ERP | Resume Parser | Recruitment Automation | Job Portal | AI Chatbot | Voice Agent | Social Media Automation | RAG Application | AI Video/Content Automation | Lead Generation Automation | Business Process Automation**

Candidates should be able to **demonstrate their actual projects during the interview.**

Business Acumen Is Essential

We are specifically looking for a developer who understands that technology must ultimately produce measurable business results.

You should be able to understand questions such as:

* Can this process be automated?
* Can AI reduce manpower or turnaround time?
* Can we improve productivity through AI?
* Can this system generate more leads or revenue?
* Can we improve customer/candidate experience?
* Can multiple manual processes be converted into one automated workflow?
* Can we build this as a scalable SaaS/product?

Candidate Profile

**Education:** B.Tech/B.E./MCA/BCA/B.Sc. Computer Science or equivalent. Exceptional developers with strong practical portfolios may also be considered.

  

We value **demonstrated ability and completed projects more than certificates alone.**

The candidate must have:

* Strong problem-solving ability
* Excellent logical and analytical thinking
* High ownership and execution capability
* Ability to learn new AI technologies quickly
* Product-development mindset
* Strong business understanding
* Passion for automation
* Ability to independently take an idea from **requirement prototype development deployment**

IMPORTANT – Apply Only If You Can Demonstrate Your Work

During the interview, candidates may be asked to demonstrate **2–3 AI/automation projects personally developed by them** and explain:

**Problem Architecture AI/LLM Used Code/Integration Automation Business Impact**

Candidates who have only theoretical knowledge of AI without hands-on development experience may not be suitable for this position.

Why Join Us?

  

You will get an opportunity to work on **real-world AI products rather than isolated experimental projects**.

Our objective is to use AI to automate business processes and develop scalable products across **HRTech, Recruitment, Skill Development, Social Media, Business Automation and SaaS platforms**.

If you are someone who sees a manual process and immediately starts thinking **“I can automate this”**, we would like to meet you.

description:
Manufacturing in Ford Motor Company is undergoing a historic transformation toward software-defined, highly connected, and intelligent manufacturing operations. At the heart of this global industrial evolution is the Ford Production System (FPS+)-Ford's next-generation digital manufacturing platform that unifies real-time plant telemetry, industrial automation, quality analytics, predictive maintenance, and logistics execution into a cohesive, high-performance ecosystem.  
  
 We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead / Senior Full-Stack Lead to spearhead end-to-end solution design, microservices architecture, and modern front-end web platforms for FPS+. In this high-impact leadership role, you will architect ultra-low latency, concurrent backend microservices using Go (Golang) and engineer responsive, high-fidelity web experiences using React.js. As Team Lead, you will drive technical excellence, champion rigorous code quality and architectural governance, solve deep system performance cha

* **End-to-End Solution Design:** Lead the technical solution design and domain-driven decomposition of services powering Ford Production System (FPS+) operations across global manufacturing facilities.
* **Go Microservices Engineering:** Design, build, and scale highly performant, resilient backend microservices utilizing Go (Golang) frameworks alongside gRPC and RESTful API protocols.
* **Concurrency High-Throughput Pipelines:** Leverage Go goroutines, channels, and worker pools to engineer event-driven message pipelines capable of processing thousands of plant-floor sensor events, telemetry signals, and industrial payloads with deterministic sub-millisecond latencies.
* **Data Persistence Distributed State:** Architect robust distributed caching and database patterns across SQL/NoSQL platforms (PostgreSQL, Cloud Spanner, Redis, MongoDB), ensuring strict ACID compliance, tenant isolation, and horizontal scale.
* **Modern React.js Web Design:** Design guide the development of dynamic, modular, and intuitive applications
* **Frontend Performance Accessibility:** Enforce Core Web Vitals excellence, bundle-size optimization (code splitting, tree shaking, lazy loading), cross-browser responsiveness.
* **Engineering Governance Code Quality:** Establish and enforce world-class coding standards, comprehensive unit/integration test coverage (aiming for >85%), and mandatory peer code reviews.
* **Performance Profiling Latency Optimization:** Conduct deep-dive profiling using Go runtime metrics and Chrome DevTools to eliminate CPU/memory bottlenecks, Goroutine leaks, and network overhead.
* **Agile Technical Ownership:** Act as technical lead for the squad, breaking down complex epics into well-defined technical user stories, conducting spike investigations, leading sprint backlog grooming, and collaborating closely with Product Managers and Solution Architects.
* **Talent Upskilling Mentorship:** Actively coach, pair-program with, and nurture junior and mid-level software developers. Cultivate deep team expertise in modern Go concurrency patterns, React clean architecture, and software craftsmanship.

* **Experience Leadership:** 8+ yea**r**s of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a Technical Lead, Lead Developer, or Software Architect capacity guiding engineering squads and technical deliverables.
* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related quantitative field.
* **Go (Golang) Mastery:** Strong hands-on expertise building production-grade microservices in Go (Golang), deep mastery of concurrency patterns (channels, sync primitives, goroutine lifecycles), memory allocation, and profiling.
* **Go Frameworks Ecosystem:** Extensive experience using Go web frameworks and building microservices communicating via gRPC / Protocol Buffers and RESTful APIs.
* **React.js Frontend Depth:** Extensive expertise in modern React.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, modern hooks, component lifecycles, state management libraries.
* **System Design Performance:** Proven ability to conduct end-to-end distributed system design, latency optimization, caching strategies, and database query tuning (PostgreSQL, Cloud SQL).
* **Cloud Containers:** Hands-on experience deploying and managing containerized applications on Kubernetes (GKE or hybrid cloud) and familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, GKE, BigQuery).
* **Code Quality Mindset:** Uncompromising focus on test-driven development (TDD), CI/CD automation, and SonarQube quality gates.
* **Cloud Certifications:** GCP Certified Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data / DevOps Engineer is a plus.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of technocrats focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

  

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

  

As we continue to grow, were always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

  

**Job Overview**

The Software Engineer is responsible for coding, testing and implementing products for our HRS Platform Team, which is increasingly focused on agentic and AI-driven engineering. This role is for engineers who have meaningfully adapted their day-to-day workflow (design, coding, testing and debugging) around AI-assisted and agentic development tools and who can bring that fluency to raise the bar for the broader team. Responsibilities include reviewing functional and technical requirements, performing research, designing solutions and developing code in a variety of programming languages for a Web + AI -based enterprise application.

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

**Engineering**

* Design, build, test and ship full-stack features in C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core Web APIs, SQL and a modern web front end.
* Write code that meets design specifications, follows team standards, and is easy to maintain.
* Review functional and technical requirements, research options, and propose designs. Write or contribute to design documents.
* Join design sessions and code reviews.

**AI-assisted engineering**

* Use AI-assisted and agentic development tools in daily work, including code generation, coding agents, AI code review and test generation, to improve both speed and quality.
* Get reliable, production-quality output from agentic tools through good context engineering: agent instructions, skills, repo conventions and guardrails.
* Coach teammates on effective and responsible AI tool use, including review discipline, security and data-handling rules.

**AI in the product**

* Build and integrate LLM features into Tracker I-9, such as document extraction, RAG, agents and tool use, using Azure OpenAI and related Azure AI services.
* Add observability, evaluation and cost and latency monitoring to AI features. Make sure they meet compliance, privacy and security requirements for employee PII.

**Quality and delivery**

* Do unit, automation and peer testing so features ship fully tested.
* Ship through CI/CD on Azure DevOps, and help improve pipelines and engineering processes.
* Document your work. Give demos, training sessions and presentations when needed.
* Work with product, QA, hosting, infrastructure and DBA teams so project requirements are met.
* Recommend refactoring, process improvements, tools and new AI-driven development practices.

  

**Required skills and experience**

* 3+ years of professional software development, mostly in C# and .NET (.NET Core).
* Strong object-oriented design, design patterns and SOLID principles.
* ASP.NET Core and MVC, building RESTful Web APIs, and validation libraries such as FluentValidation.
* 3+ years of SQL and relational databases (Azure SQL / SQL Server), including query tuning, plus an ORM such as Entity Framework Core or Dapper.
* Front-end development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework (Angular preferred). Experience with Bootstrap and jQuery is useful for legacy modules.
* Cloud development on Microsoft Azure: App Service, Functions, Storage, Key Vault and Managed Identity.
* CI/CD and Git on Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards).
* Unit testing and mocking with NUnit or xUnit and Moq or NSubstitute. Familiarity with test automation.
* Authentication and security protocols, including OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and secure coding practices (OWASP).
* **Hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools** such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar in your normal workflow. You should be able to explain specifically how they changed the way you design, code, test and debug.
* Understanding of how to manage agent instructions, skills, context and guardrails to get consistent, production-quality results from agentic tools.
* At least one shipped project where AI-assisted development clearly sped up delivery or improved quality.
* Strong logical reasoning, predictable delivery, and clear written and spoken communication.

  

***We are an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status.***

This role is to build, design solutions, and maintain our platform for scale.

The ideal candidate will be naturally curious and has experience building software systems to manage and deploy reliable and performant infrastructure and product code at scale on a cloud infrastructure.

- Work with senior engineering team in major development projects, design and implementation

- Conduct code reviews, analysis and performance tuning

- Work with QA team to outline and implement comprehensive test coverage for broad features

- Provide support and handle incoming bugs and customer reported issues

title: Software Engineer 2 - Frontend
description:
Overview
Search is how people find their work. Every day, people in organizations of every size rely on it to locate the document they edited last week, the email that captured a decision, the colleague who knows the answer, or the meeting where it was all discussed. When search works, it disappears into the flow of work; when it does not, it costs time, focus and confidence.
In Microsoft 365 Copilot, we are reimagining search with AI. Copilot Search understands what you mean, brings together email, files, chats, meetings and people, and composes a grounded answer with sources you can trust, right alongside the results you need to go deeper. We are looking for a Software Engineer II excited to build this experience at global scale.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and ship Copilot Search features end to end in React and TypeScript, from design review and implementation through experimentation and worldwide rollout.
- Build performant, accessible and localized user interfaces that work consistently across web, desktop and mobile hosts, as well as SharePoint and OneDrive.
- Drive web performance through server-side rendering, hydration and rendering optimization, early data fetching, service workers and bundle-size reduction, with a focus on end-to-end latency and time to first answer.
- Integrate AI-generated answers into the search experience, including streaming responses, citations and source attribution, and graceful handling of partial or failed responses.
- Instrument features with telemetry, define success metrics, and run A/B experiments and staged rollouts to make data-driven product decisions.
- Own the reliability of the features you build, including monitoring, alerting, automated health checks and diagnosis of client issues such as authentication and host-loading failures.
- Participate in the team's on-call rotation, mitigating production incidents quickly and driving root-cause fixes so they do not recur.
- Partner closely with product managers, designers and backend search and relevance engineers to turn ambiguous ideas into polished, shippable experiences.
- Raise the engineering bar through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing and contributions to shared components and engineering practices.
- Use AI-assisted development tools and LLM-based techniques, such as automated analysis of user feedback and quality evaluation, to move faster and improve product quality.

Qualifications
Required/Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.- OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Solid experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript.
- Solid web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, browser rendering, web performance and server-side rendering.
- Experience building and operating large-scale web applications used by a broad customer base.
- Experience with telemetry, A/B experimentation and data-driven decision making.
- Working knowledge of accessibility standards and building inclusive user interfaces.
- Experience building LLM or AI-powered product features, such as streaming experiences.
- Exposure to mobile or cross-platform hosts, such as web experiences embedded in apps.
- Experience with live-site operations, monitoring and on-call responsibilities.
- Familiarity with search or information retrieval concepts is a plus.
- Solid problem-solving and communication skills, and comfort collaborating across time zones.

title: Intermediate Backend Engineer , Security Factory
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in their code by contributing to the static analysis engine that finds them.

Your work spans both the engine and the tools we use to evaluate it. You'll extend how the engine models programs, from parsing source code and resolving symbols to building call graphs and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You'll also build and apply tooling to test its findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, measuring both false positives and missed vulnerabilities.

We build the engine with artificial intelligence (AI) agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. You'll implement component specifications within the team's architecture, working with engineers and AI agents. Good judgment about when to trust agent output, and when to bring it to human review, is central to the role.

What you'll do

- Extend the program model, including parsing, symbol resolution, intermediate representations, call graphs, and taint and data-flow analysis, to support new languages and frameworks.

- Build and apply AI-assisted tooling to implement, review, and validate engine changes and findings, in collaboration with the team's technical leadership. Measure detection quality against known vulnerabilities, judging changes primarily on false positive and false negative rates.

- Develop static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP), along with test fixtures that demonstrate they work.

- Implement component specifications with engineers and AI agents through phased plans and small, reviewable changes. Keep specifications and code in sync.

- Improve the harness, agent instructions, and skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy. Use separate coding and reviewing agents, performance checks, application programming interface (API) checks, and dependency checks, and escalate risky changes to human review.

- Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity, and identify and address technical debt that slows the team down.

- Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review.

- Participate in on-call rotations to help troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.

What you'll bring

- Experience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to assess when their output is trustworthy.

- Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Rust or Go. Our engine is written in Rust, the analyzer wrapper in Go, and the monolith integration in Ruby. You'll be willing to work across them.

- An interest in static analysis and application security, including parsing, intermediate representations, taint and data-flow analysis, and how vulnerabilities arise in code. Deep expertise isn't required; we'll help you grow it.

- Organize and progress your work independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.

- The ability to communicate technical problems clearly and concisely and propose iterative solutions.

- Helpful but not required: experience with performance optimization, Docker and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), web or mobile frameworks, guardrails for agent-written code such as mutation testing and fuzzing, or program analysis and security research through publications or open source contributions. Willingness to learn performance optimization and containerized workflows is also welcome.

About the team

The Security Factory: Code Scanning team develops GitLab's SAST capabilities for customer software repositories. We work closely with the Code Security team on scanning rules and flows, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.

At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

- Flexible Paid Time Off 

- Team Member Resource Groups

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

- Growth and Development Fund
